checks: Seeded one synthetic reviewed world, all five published dossier kinds and a private unpublished sentinel using live-role SQL/RPC in disposable PostgreSQL.

Anonymous navigation, all five sections, client search and dossier reading work with consumer rollout disabled; literal markup stays text and hidden draft/source data is absent from API, HTML and embedded payloads.

The real editor UI saves and previews a dossier without publishing; a signed editor can read the private draft, while anonymous users redirect and unrelated signed accounts cannot read it. Private source records remain absent even from saved-preview presentation.
A publisher explicitly releases the saved UI revision and archives it through actual browser controls; public visibility follows both operations without exposing source evidence.
Revoking the editor's real database session makes an already-open editor Save fail with401 and preserves the entire saved revision; a subsequent private-preview navigation returns to login.

Forty captures cover lore landing/world/category/detail in both themes at320/390/768/1024/1440px; new reader controls meet44px, every page has one main heading, long text stays contained and the selected theme survives reload.
Keyboard focus is visible, the labelled search works from the keyboard and reduced-motion preference is active.
